item.title: Dear Abby: Pal’s ‘supportive’ sis an alcoholic nightmare
item.description: Louis moved, not realizing his sister was a severe alcoholic. She'd come home from work, have six or eight drinks and become really belligerent with both her husband and Louis. She even gave Louis 30 days to get out of her house.
